title: HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?
abstract: arXiv:2611.30422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hardware benchmarks for LLM agents all run the design flow forward, from a specification to RTL, a layout or a bug fix. We ask the reverse question: given an implemented artifact, such as a layout, a gate-level netlist or a protected simulation model, can an agent work out what it does well enough to act on that knowledge? We introduce HWRE-Bench, a benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering built on one observation. Each step of the forward flow discards information (names, hierarchy, word-level structure, generator parameters, the programming model), and a reverse-engineering task asks the agent to recover what was lost and to prove it with an executable deliverable that the artifact alone cannot supply. Since layout extraction is now mechanical and a correct netlist is already a cycle-exact model, every task carries a mandatory copy-the-netlist control that must score zero. translated_title: HWRE-Bench：大语言模型智能体能理解并非由其设计的硬件吗？
translated_abstract: 面向大语言模型智能体的硬件基准测试全都沿设计流程正向运行，即从规格说明到 RTL、版图或缺陷修复。我们提出一个相反的问题：给定一个已实现的制品（如版图、门级网表或受保护的仿真模型），智能体能否充分弄清其功能，从而基于该知识采取行动？我们提出 HWRE-Bench，一个基于智能体的硬件逆向工程基准，其建立在一个观察之上：正向流程的每一步都会丢弃信息（名称、层次结构、字级结构、生成器参数、编程模型），而逆向工程任务要求智能体恢复这些丢失的信息，并通过制品本身无法提供的可执行交付物来证明其理解。由于版图提取如今已是机械化过程，且正确的网表本身就是一个周期精确的模型，因此每个任务都带有一个必须得分为零的强制“复制网表”对照实验。HWRE-Bench 涵盖五个赛道（Extract 提取、Abstract 抽象、Audi……摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出首个面向大语言模型智能体的硬件逆向工程基准 HWRE-Bench，要求智能体从版图、网表等已实现制品中恢复正向设计流程丢失的信息，并以可执行交付物证明其理解，同时通过强制“复制网表”对照实验确保任务真正考察逆向理解能力。
en_tdlr: HWRE-Bench introduces the first benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering, requiring LLM agents to recover information lost during the forward design flow from implemented artifacts and prove their understanding with executable deliverables, with a mandatory copy-the-netlist control ensuring tasks genuinely test reverse engineering ability.
